records.findings_summary: Flag found via Forensic VM analysis: downloaded the challenge OVA (GhostInTheThread.ova) from the Google Drive link, converted the streamOptimized VMDK to raw with qemu-img, located the GPT root ext4 partition (sector 135168), extracted the sysadmin's custom XKB layout (/usr/share/X11/xkb/symbols/custom, inode 65300) with Sleuth Kit icat, reconstructed the QWERTY key->letter mapping, and identified it as the Gallium (Colstag) layout by exact row match against the upstream Gallium repo. The challenge explicitly stated no sun{} wrapper, just the layout name.: Gallium | Evidence: Challenge text (from submission page): 'ghost in the thread - 2' — 'What keyboard layout was the sysadmin here using? refer to ghost in the thread (1) for the challenge.' / 'No sun{} flag format, just the layout name.' ; GhostInTheThread.ova (tar, 126,945,280 B) downloaded from https://drive.usercontent.google.com/download?id=1fFWJp6tfT8U6bh0uuhB4AkDv-sdDCf_W ; contains GhostInTheThread.ovf + GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk (2 GiB streamOptimized). ; qemu-img info: vmdk, create type streamOptimized, compressed; qemu-img convert -O raw -> 2 GiB disk.raw. GPT shows ext4 '/' partition starting at sector 135168. ; fls/icat (offset 135168) lists /usr/share/X11/xkb/symbols/custom (inode 65300). solution_steps: 从题目描述拿到 Google Drive 链接，用 curl 处理 Google Drive 的病毒扫描确认页（提取 confirm=t 和 uuid），下载 GhostInTheThread.ova（tar，约 126 MB）。
解包 OVA 得到 GhostInTheThread-disk1.vmdk（streamOptimized 稀疏格式）。安装/调用 qemu-img convert -O raw 转为 disk.raw（2 GiB）。
用 GPT 解析或 mmls 得知 ext4 根分区从扇区 135168 开始；用 fls -o 135168 列出文件，找到挑战相关文件（/usr/share/X11/xkb/symbols/custom、/srv/sunchan/*、/var/lib/sunchan/board.sqlite 等）。
用 icat -o 135168 disk.raw 65300 > custom.txt 取出 xkb 自定义布局文件，内容为 name[Group1]="my layout" 及 31 个 key 映射（含 name[Group1]）。
按 XKB 键位约定（AD01=Q…AC01=A…AB01=Z）把映射还原成三行键盘布局：bldcvjyou, / nrtsgphaei / xqmwzkf';.。
与公开布局比对，发现与 Gallium（Colstag 变体）完全一致（Gallium 由 GalileoBlues 设计，见 github.com/GalileoBlues/Gallium；getreuer.info 的 alt-layouts 指南也推荐 Gallium）。
题目说明无 sun{} 格式，只需布局名，提交 'Gallium'，页面返回 Correct 且该题标记为 ✦ Solved。
evidence: Challenge text (from submission page): 'ghost in the thread - 2' — 'What keyboard layout was the sysadmin here using? refer to ghost in the thread (1) for the challenge.' / 'No sun{} flag format, just the layout name.'

This is a byte-for-byte exact match to the canonical Gallium (Colstag) layout rows fetched from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/GalileoBlues/Gallium@main/Images/Gallium_Colstag.svg which read 'B L D C V J Y O U , N R T S G P H A E I X Q M W Z K F ' ; .' (Gallium by GalileoBlues, https://github.com/GalileoBlues/Gallium).
Submitted flag 'Gallium' -> submission page alert strong 'Correct', and the challenge row changed to 'Forensics ✦ Solved ghost in the thread - 2 (137 solves)'.

Independent extra confirmation: the VM's /usr/lib/security/pam_unix.so (inode 3195) is a planted backdoor exporting symbols artifact_description and configured_password (used by the sibling part 4), showing this OVA is the shared 'ghost in the thread' forensic image.
